termsMenuDesc: Usage guidelines, prayer accuracy & legal terms
ppSection1Body: SalahFirst is a distraction-free Islamic companion designed with an offline-first architecture. This document explains what data is processed, how external network requests function, and how your privacy is safeguarded.
ppSection2Body: SalahFirst does not require user accounts, email addresses, phone numbers, or registration. No personal profiles or identity records are ever created or maintained on remote servers.
ppSection3Body: To determine prayer times and Qibla direction, the app can access your location if granted. GPS coordinates (latitude and longitude) are stored locally on your device in private application storage.
ppSection4Body: Astronomical prayer times and Qibla compass bearings are computed entirely on-device using mathematical models. An active internet connection is not required for daily prayer schedules or Qibla orientation.
ppSection5Body: When you tap 'Use Current Location' or search for a city, the app sends coordinates or search terms to OpenStreetMap's Nominatim service (nominatim.openstreetmap.org). This request is processed ephemerally to retrieve city names. OpenStreetMap may retain standard server access logs including IP addresses per its own privacy policy.
ppSection6Body: If you choose to use the 'Verify with AlAdhan' feature in Settings, coordinates and calculation parameters are sent over HTTPS to api.aladhan.com. This request is optional, user-initiated, and processed ephemerally for time comparison.
ppSection7Body: The in-app Adhan preview streams audio over HTTPS from AlAdhan's content delivery network (cdn.aladhan.com). Your device IP address is processed temporarily by the CDN to deliver the audio stream.
ppSection8Body: Prayer reminders and daily reflection alerts are scheduled locally using Android system alarm mechanisms. SalahFirst does not transmit device push tokens or register with remote push notification servers.
ppSection9Body: Prayer completion checkmarks, streaks, Tasbih counts, Focus Mode logs, and notification preferences are saved exclusively in local storage (AsyncStorage) on your device. This data is never sent to external servers and is deleted if you clear app storage or uninstall the app.
ppSection10Body: When you choose to save an authentic Hadith wallpaper, SalahFirst writes the generated image to your device photo gallery. The app requests write-only access and does not read, scan, or access any existing photos on your device.
ppSection11Body: SalahFirst does not sell, rent, or trade user data. External requests occur solely to fulfill user-requested features: OpenStreetMap for geocoding, AlAdhan for verification, and AlAdhan CDN for audio preview.
ppSection12Body: All app data is stored locally on your device. You can delete all data at any time by clearing app data in Android Settings or uninstalling the app. We do not operate remote user databases, so server-side deletion requests do not apply.
ppSection13Body: All external communications use industry-standard HTTPS encryption (TLS 1.2/1.3) to protect data in transit. Local data is protected within Android's sandboxed application storage.
ppSection14Body: SalahFirst does not collect personal information from any user, including children under the age of 13. The application is safe for users of all ages.
ppSection15Body: For questions, feedback, or privacy-related inquiries, please reach out via the official developer contact page.
tcSection1Body: By downloading, installing, or using SalahFirst, you agree to be bound by these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, please do not use the application.
tcSection2Body: SalahFirst is a mobile application offering Islamic prayer time calculations, Qibla compass orientation, Tasbih counting, prayer tracking, Hadith wallpapers, and Focus Mode utilities.
tcSection3Body: SalahFirst is designed as a personal spiritual productivity companion. Users are responsible for selecting the appropriate calculation conventions and juristic preferences that align with their local community standards.
tcSection4Body: Prayer times are calculated using recognized astronomical algorithms. Minor differences may occur depending on elevation, atmospheric conditions, and chosen conventions (e.g., Karachi, Umm al-Qura, MWL, ISNA, Hanafi vs. Standard Asr). Users should verify with their local mosque or religious authority.
tcSection5Body: Qibla compass accuracy relies on your device's internal magnetometer and accelerometer sensors. Magnetic interference, metal objects, or uncalibrated device sensors may affect bearing accuracy. Periodic figure-8 device calibration is recommended.
tcSection6Body: Prayer reminders are scheduled locally. Delivery timing depends on Android operating system conditions, battery optimization modes, Doze mode, and device power-saving settings. SalahFirst cannot guarantee exact alarm delivery on devices with strict background restrictions.
tcSection7Body: The in-app Adhan preview streams from an external CDN and requires active internet access. Offline audio availability depends on network conditions and external server uptime.
tcSection8Body: Hadith citations in the app are sourced from classical collections (Sahih al-Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, Sunan Abi Dawud, Jami` at-Tirmidhi). References are provided for educational and devotional purposes.
tcSection9Body: Hadith wallpapers generated within the app are permitted for personal, non-commercial use, such as lock screen wallpapers and personal social sharing. Commercial redistribution or resale of generated artwork is prohibited.
tcSection10Body: The SalahFirst codebase, branding, interface designs, and 3D assets are the intellectual property of the developer. Third-party calculation libraries and APIs remain property of their respective creators.
tcSection11Body: SalahFirst is a supplementary technical aid. It does not issue religious fatwas, rulings, or replace qualified Islamic scholarship. Users should consult trusted local Islamic scholars regarding specific worship obligations.
tcSection12Body: Core features operate offline. However, the developer does not guarantee uninterrupted operation or error-free calculations under all operating system versions and handset conditions.
tcSection13Body: To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, the developer shall not be liable for any missed prayers, indirect damages, or inaccuracies resulting from sensor discrepancies, battery restrictions, or device clock errors.
tcSection14Body: We reserve the right to revise these Terms & Conditions as the application evolves. Continued use of SalahFirst following any updates constitutes acceptance of the modified terms.
tcSection15Body: For questions, feedback, or inquiries regarding these Terms & Conditions, please reach out via the official developer contact page.
